Module com.tasktopia
Package com.tasktopia.model

Class Task

java.lang.Object
com.tasktopia.model.Task
public class Task extends Object
Represents a task in the Tasktopia application.

A Task can be created in two ways, reflected by two constructors:

  • The database constructor (used by SqliteTaskDAO) accepts a full date-time range, tags, and a user ID.
  • The GUI constructor (used by TaskStore) accepts a date, time, Task.Category, and Task.Priority for the UI-driven workflow.
Both paths share the same underlying fields; unused fields remain null or default-valued.

  • Constructor Details

    • Task

      public Task(String title, LocalDateTime startDate, LocalDateTime endDate, String description, String tags, int userId)
      Constructs a Task for database persistence. Used primarily by SqliteTaskDAO when reading from or writing to the database.
      Parameters:
      title - the title of the task; must not be null
      startDate - the start date and time of the task
      endDate - the end (due) date and time of the task
      description - a longer description of the task
      tags - a comma-separated string of tags associated with the task
      userId - the ID of the user who owns this task

    • Task

      public Task(String name, String description, LocalDate date, LocalTime time, Task.Category category, Task.Priority priority)
      Constructs a Task for the GUI workflow. Used by TaskStore and UI controllers when creating tasks via the interface.
      Parameters:
      name - the display name (title) of the task
      description - a longer description of the task
      date - the date on which the task is scheduled
      time - the time at which the task is scheduled
      category - the built-in Task.Category of the task
      priority - the Task.Priority level of the task
